projects.name: Work Buddy AI
projects.description: AI-powered workplace and meeting analytics SaaS: a multi-tenant platform for a Japanese enterprise client combining AI meeting transcription and productivity scoring with real-time workspace usage analytics.
highlights: Built the real-time AI Meeting Worker detecting silence, speaker imbalance and time overruns during live meetings, with an SSE streaming layer delivering AI summaries and agenda updates live.
Restored production reliability of the WebSocket-based AI worker by eliminating a session resource leak on client disconnect and a context-overflow issue in long sessions.
Delivered the hardware device integration linking physical meeting recorders to user accounts, plus the invitation and RBAC module for tenant onboarding.

projects.name: KzComtor Platform
projects.description: Internal real-time AI collaboration platform for multilingual communication using AI speech recognition and translation workflows.
highlights: Contributed to the architectural design bridging real-time communication protocols with scalable frontend and backend services.
Integrated the Soniox Speech-to-Text engine and context optimization pipelines, boosting voice recognition and domain terminology accuracy from 60% to 90%.
Built responsive UIs and JWT + RBAC authentication with secure API middleware.

projects.name: Docmind AI
projects.description: Internal AI document processing platform using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for semantic search and contextual interaction with Markdown and Google Docs.
highlights: Built full-stack functionality: RESTful APIs and UIs for the document processing workflow.
Optimized the summarization engine for large documents, reducing processing time by 70% while preserving core context.
Used Redis caching and background job queues for asynchronous embedding generation, reducing server load under concurrent traffic.

projects.name: SellGame Platform
projects.description: Digital asset marketplace for secure listing, purchasing and management of gaming accounts and virtual items.
highlights: Architected a secure NestJS marketplace backend handling concurrent user operations.
Engineered a multi-tier listing validation engine and secure checkout workflow to prevent fraud and keep data integrity at peak traffic.
Optimized relational schemas with multi-attribute indexing, accelerating catalog search and filtering under heavy load.
